text:
Come, friends, let us embark

on the journey of the drop of water.

It is a drop, barely, like a bird's eye.


For us it is only a point,

a seed of light,

a seed of water,

half the tears of a smile,

but the sky fits inside it

and it would be the shipwreck of an ant.


Come, friends, let us follow

the orbit of the drop of water:

From the crest of a wave

it leaps, with the morning vapor;

it rises to the shore of a cloud

islanded in the sky, white as a beach;

it travels toward the West,

rains on a mountain peak,

brightens the leaves,

glazes the shoots,

rolls through a ravine,

is seasoned in the juice of fallen fruit,

jumps in the waterfalls,

flows into the river, runs toward the East,

cuts the savanna in two,

performs pirouettes in the whirlpools,

and in the broad still pools expands

like a cat's pupil,

continues eastward on the ebb tide,

reaches the sea, the crest of its wave,

and we have arrived, friends… We will return tomorrow.

translation.title: The Orbit of Water
translation.editorial_note: The translation follows the drop’s complete orbit and preserves the recurring address to the friends.
